spawn_process_with_pty: spawn a child process behind a pseudo-terminal using PtyBridge.spawn with argv and cwd
read_from_pty: read raw bytes from the PTY master fd with a configurable timeout using PtyBridge.read
write_to_pty: write raw bytes to the PTY master to feed input into the child process using PtyBridge.write
resize_pty_terminal: forward a terminal resize event to the child process via TIOCSWINSZ using PtyBridge.resize
check_pty_availability: check if pseudo-terminals are available on the current platform using PtyBridge.is_available
